page.unresolvedRefs: {{count}} references could not be resolved: an evidence-integrity defect.
page.noRiskTitle: No risk observed at this engine version.
page.noRiskBody: No detector fired. This is not a statement that the claim is clean or safe, only that this engine version observed nothing.

actionMeaning.REJECT_SIGNAL: The case is closed with a reason. An authorised reviewer can still reopen it.
actionMeaning.REQUEST_EVIDENCE: The case moves to awaiting evidence. Deferring with a recorded reason is a legitimate decision.
actionMeaning.CONFIRM_ANOMALY: You are confirming an inconsistency that needs following up. This is not a finding of fraud.
actionMeaning.ESCALATE: The case is flagged for authorised investigation. No sanction, payment, or notification follows automatically.

REJECT_SIGNAL: Supporting evidence was found outside this bundle
A legitimate follow-up, not repeat billing
Staged care that was genuinely planned
The entered-in-error marking has been corrected
REQUEST_EVIDENCE: The procedure record has not been sent
A written explanation from the facility is needed
An evidence reference could not be resolved
CONFIRM_ANOMALY: A line billed with no evidence of a completed service
Overlapping claims in the same episode
One episode split across several claims
Documentation copied with no reasonable explanation
ESCALATE: Needs investigation by an authorised unit
A recurring pattern at this facility
Value and impact beyond a reviewer's authority

supportMeaning.SUPPORTED: The expected supporting evidence was found in this bundle.
supportMeaning.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Some of the expected evidence was found, some was not.
supportMeaning.UNSUPPORTED: The expected evidence is absent while the file is declared complete.
supportMeaning.NOT_ASSESSABLE: The file is incomplete, so this line cannot be judged yet — which is not the same as the evidence being absent.

availabilityMeaning.PRESENT: This resource was sent with the claim and is shown as it arrived.
availabilityMeaning.RELATED_BUNDLE: This resource comes from another submission being compared. Only fields that do not reveal another participant's identity are shown.
availabilityMeaning.NOT_STORED: Episodes and practitioners are referenced by identity and are deliberately not stored as resources of their own. This is not a defect.
availabilityMeaning.MISSING: This reference points at a resource that could not be resolved. That is an evidence-integrity defect, not a normal empty view.

matrixCellMeaning.FOUND: A reason citing this line points at a resource of this type, and that resource can be opened.
matrixCellMeaning.MISSING: A reason citing this line expected evidence of this type and did not find it in the bundle.
matrixCellMeaning.UNRESOLVED: There is a reference of this type, but it points at a resource that could not be resolved. That is an evidence-integrity defect.
matrixCellMeaning.NOT_EXPECTED: No reason expects evidence of this type on this line. Empty does not mean absent.

conflict.withReason: The case moved to “{{state}}” with the reason “{{reason}}”.
conflict.generic: This case changed after you opened it.

lines.heading: Claim lines
lines.hint: Choose a line to load its evidence trail
lines.empty: This bundle carries no claim lines that can be shown.

disposition.heading: Disposition
disposition.reasonNote: A reason is required and is stored permanently. The system only offers options; it never chooses for you.
disposition.evidenceNote: Ticked automatically from the resources that are missing; add or remove as needed.
disposition.notePlaceholder: Further explanation for the audit trail
disposition.versions: case version {{case}} · rules v{{ruleset}} · engine v{{engine}}
disposition.permanent: This decision is recorded permanently along with who made it, when, why, and the engine version.

banner.conflictTitle: Case version mismatch: this case changed after you opened it
banner.conflictBody: {{summary}} The change was recorded by <1>{{by}}</1> at {{at}}; the case version moved from {{seen}} to {{current}}. <3>Your disposition entries have been kept</3>: nothing was overwritten and nothing was recorded.
banner.saveFailedTitle: The disposition could not be saved
banner.saveFailedBody: {{detail}} No audit event was partly written; an event is written whole or not at all. <1>Your entries are still intact on screen.</1>

placeholder.notFoundBody: This case identifier does not exist in the system. The link may be out of date, or the database may have been re-screened since it was made.
placeholder.failedTitle: The case detail could not be loaded
placeholder.failedBody: {{detail}} This does not mean the case is absent; its detail simply did not reach this screen.

confirmAnomaly.title: Confirm anomaly: this is not a fraud finding
confirmAnomaly.description: Read this statement before the decision is recorded permanently.
confirmAnomaly.lede: Confirming means you agree there is <1>an inconsistency that needs following up</1>. That is all. This action is <3>not</3> a statement of fraud, not a legal finding, and not an accusation against anyone.
confirmAnomaly.point2: · Payment is neither stopped nor changed.

header.noRisk: No risk observed at this engine version. This is not a statement that the claim is clean.
header.bandCaveat: {{basis}} This band raises review priority. It does not reject the claim, and it does not allege fraud.

auditPanel.heading: Case audit history
auditPanel.empty: No event has been recorded for this case yet.
auditPanel.lede: Every event records who acted, what they did, why, when, which evidence was cited, and the engine version. Entries are never deleted or overwritten.
auditPanel.failed: The history could not be loaded. That does not mean this case has no history; the list simply did not reach this screen.

swimlane.heading: Episode timeline
swimlane.empty: This bundle carries no events that can be ordered in time.

matrixPanel.heading: Evidence matrix
matrixPanel.empty: This bundle carries no claim lines that can be shown.
matrixPanel.lede: Billed lines against the kinds of evidence expected of them. An empty cell means nothing was expected there, not that something is absent.
matrixPanel.noReasons: No risk was observed at this engine version, so there is no expected evidence to map. This is not a statement about the claim.

reasonCard.counterEmpty: No counter-evidence for this reason was found in the available bundle.
reasonCard.expectedEmpty: This rule does not specify a particular evidence type.
reasonCard.foundEmpty: No supporting resource was found for this reason.

map.heading: Evidence map
map.empty: No reason is being traced yet. Open a reason card to see its evidence map.
map.counterEmpty: There is no counter-evidence for this reason.
map.footnote: One path, not a web of relations. Leaf nodes are not connected to one another; a node with no supporting resource stops there.

source.raw: The resource's contents as they are, exactly as the system received them.
source.screenedVersions: ENGINE VERSION WHEN THE CASE WAS SCREENED

comparison.title: Candidate pair comparison
comparison.description: This case on the left, the comparison candidate on the right. Only the relevant excerpts are shown.
comparison.noCandidateCase: There is no case to open for this candidate yet.
comparison.noOverlap: No part of the two overlaps in time. The absence of an overlap in fact weakens a repeat-billing reading.

draft.pickReason: Choose a structured reason. There is no disposition without one.
